claims: The 98th Academy Awards honor films from 2025.
The 98th Academy Awards will be held on March 15, 2026.
Ryan Coogler’s Sinners is leading with a record-breaking 16 nominations for the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners is a vampire horror thriller.
One Battle After Another has 13 nominations for the 98th Academy Awards.

Key contenders for Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards include Sinners, One Battle After Another, Bugonia, Marty Supreme, Hamnet, Sentimental Value, Frankenstein, The Secret Agent, Train Dreams, F1.

Key contenders for Best Actress at the 98th Academy Awards include Jessie Buckley (Hamnet), Rose Byrne (If I Had Legs I'd Kick You), Kate Hudson (Song Sung Blue), Renate Reinsve (Sentimental Value), Emma Stone (Bugonia).

Key contenders for Best Actor at the 98th Academy Awards include Michael B. Jordan (Sinners), Timothée Chalamet (Marty Supreme), Leonardo DiCaprio (One Battle After Another), Wagner Moura (The Secret Agent), Ethan Hawke (Blue Moon).

Key contenders for Best Supporting Actress at the 98th Academy Awards include Teyana Taylor (One Battle After Another), Amy Madigan (Weapons), Wunmi Mosaku (Sinners), Inga Ibsdotter Lilleaas (Sentimental Value), Elle Fanning (Sentimental Value).

Key contenders for Best Supporting Actor at the 98th Academy Awards include Delroy Lindo (Sinners), Jacob Elordi (Frankenstein), Stellan Skarsgård (Sentimental Value), Sean Penn (One Battle After Another).
Key contenders for Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards include Ryan Coogler (Sinners), Paul Thomas Anderson (One Battle After Another).
Key contenders for Best Animated Feature at the 98th Academy Awards include Elio, Zootopia 2, KPop Demon Hunters, Arco.
The Academy added a Best Casting award category for the first time in 25 years.
Sinners won at the Golden Globes.
Sinners won at the Critics' Choice.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony will be broadcast live from the Dolby Theatre.
